artworks.title: Tiens... je ne te reconnaissais pas...
artworks.description: The image shows two men standing. The man on the left is facing sideways with his legs slightly apart, seemingly speaking. He has short hair and wears a dark coat over a white shirt and light pants. The man on the right faces forward with his hands in his coat pockets, has a long beard, and wears a high-crowned hat. He is dressed in a long, dark overcoat over lighter trousers. There is a framed painting on the wall behind them showing a landscape. The setting seems to be indoors with a neutral-toned wall as the backdrop.

artworks.title: Ce satané Pigochard...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a street scene with two uniformed guards and a civilian. The drawing depicts an interaction between three figures on a cobblestone street. Two are dressed in military uniforms with hats, one carrying a rifle, while the third figure appears to be in civilian attire, wearing a hat and a skirt. They appear to be engaged in a conversation. The background consists of a row of building facades fading into the distance and a large structure on the right with a small circular window. The shading and use of lines create a sense of depth and realism in the urban setting.

artworks.title: L'Interdiction du port des décorations
artworks.description: The image shows three men standing closely together. The man on the left has short, wavy hair and a receding hairline. He is wearing a dark jacket, a light-colored shirt, and plaid trousers. The middle man is holding a newspaper, wearing round spectacles, short, curly hair, and a dark suit. The man on the right has light-colored, wavy hair and is inspecting the inside of his jacket pocket. He is wearing a dark jacket, a partially buttoned shirt, and striped trousers. The background is a simple, shaded setting with no distinct elements.

artworks.title: Le Voyage en chemin de fer...
artworks.description: The image shows four individuals sitting in a wooden interior space. They are all seated with their heads tilted backwards. The figures have indistinct facial features and are wearing military attire. The benches they sit on are plain, and their hats are placed nearby. One individual leans against the wall. Outside the windows, there is a serene landscape with rolling fields.

artworks.title: Rifolard est plus charmé que jamais...
artworks.description: The image shows three military officers from the waist up, marching closely together. They wear dark uniforms with epaulettes and sashes, and tall hats decorated with flowers. The officer in the middle holds a bouquet of flowers, looking forward. The officer on the left looks up, appearing distressed, while the officer on the right looks content, holding flowers to his chest with closed eyes. More officers in similar uniforms are faintly visible in the background. The setting is outdoors among tall buildings, with flowers raining down on the street. People on balconies can be seen throwing flowers at the procession.

artworks.title: Plusieurs gardes nationaux qui n'avaient pas songé...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene on a ship's deck. The drawing depicts a chaotic scene aboard a ship with dramatic gestures and expressions. Several figures are on the deck; one is holding a large bowl, seemingly offering aid to the others who appear distressed. The figures are dressed in period clothing, hinting at a historical context. The deck is tilted, and the sails are furled above, suggesting movement or a challenging voyage. The background shows the sea with another sailboat visible in the distance. The drawing uses cross-hatching and shading to create a textured and dynamic atmosphere.

artworks.title: Décidément nous nous amusons trop, Guillochard!...
artworks.description: The image shows two men. One is seated, leaning back on a chair with his right hand on the chair back and left hand on his stomach, looking upwards. He has a round face, short wavy hair, and wears a formal outfit with unique shoulder detail and a large belt or sash at the waist. The other man is standing to the right, slightly bent forward, focusing on an object in his left hand while using his right hand to interact with it. He has curly hair, facial hair, an earnest expression, and wears formal attire with military-like epaulets and a wide sash. In the background, there is a faint illustration of several figures against floor-to-ceiling drapery, suggesting an interior setting.

artworks.title: Les Deux banqueteurs en joie
artworks.description: The image shows two men standing closely together, facing each other. Both men have mustaches, wear glasses, and are dressed in similar uniform-like outfits with high collars, sashes at the waist, and ornate hats. One man has tightly curled hair and the other has wavy hair peeking out from his hat. Their arms are around each other's shoulders. In the background, there is a simple sketch of distant buildings, trees, and shrubbery.

artworks.title: Les Journaux Napoléoniens sortant de l'Assemblée Nationale...
artworks.description: There are three comical figures in exaggerated attire in this drawing. The figures have oversized noses and wear old-fashioned top hats. They stand in front of a doorway labeled "ASSEMBLE." The figures wear stripes and plaids on their clothing. One figure holds a cane. Two of the figures have labels on their hats, "PRÊTEUR" and "COASTEUR." The drawing shows careful shading and line work.

artworks.title: Un Déménagement furtif
artworks.description: Three figures are depicted in the image. Two men are on a small platform indoors, with one gesturing towards a woman peeking from a small window. The man on the left has curly hair, wearing a top hat, bow tie, and a long coat, holding a cane. In the middle, a heavily cloaked figure lacks visible facial features, with a checked garment underneath covering the head. The man on the right wears a cap and similar long attire. A plain wall is visible behind them. An elderly woman in the window looks curious. The image appears to be a charcoal or pencil drawing.

artworks.title: Comment on comprend le balcon Espagnol a Paris
artworks.description: The image shows two people standing on a small balcony. Both individuals are facing each other with their hands resting on the railing. The person on the left has short hair styled back and a sharp facial outline. The person on the right has short hair and their head tilted slightly back. Both individuals are wearing dark outer garments that appear to be coats. A piece of fabric or scarf is caught in the wind between them. There are no visible jewelry or held objects. The background features a cityscape with buildings and rooftops under a lightly clouded sky.

artworks.title: Un Locataire qui paie exactement son terme
artworks.description: The image shows two people on a staircase. The man is climbing the stairs while holding a top hat in his right hand and grasping a railing with his left hand. He is dressed in a dark coat, dark trousers, and shoes. The woman stands on the stairs, facing the man. She has a pointed nose, round spectacles, and pinned back hair, and wears a patterned robe with vertical stripes and house slippers. The background features a plain wall curving with the stairs.

artworks.title: Le Compte est-il bien exact?...
artworks.description: The image depicts two men in a room. The man on the left is standing, leaning over a table with both hands on its surface, while the man on the right is seated, leaning forward with one hand gripping the back of his chair. The man on the left has short, light-colored hair and a somber expression, wearing a dark, long-sleeved garment. The man on the right has a pronounced nose, an open mouth, and wears a dark hat; his hair is not distinctly visible. His attire consists of a patterned jacket worn over a shirt, light-colored pants, and stockings. The table holds a large book and a few stacks of coins. Behind them, the room is sparsely decorated with a framed picture on the wall. The setting appears to be a dimly lit room, suggestive of an old-fashioned or classic setting, possibly an office or study.

artworks.title: Eh! bien monsieur et mes trois termes...
artworks.description: The image shows two men standing face to face. The man on the left has hunched shoulders, hands in his pockets, a serious expression, an angular nose, and wears a tall top hat. He is dressed in a dark overcoat and striped trousers. The man on the right is bent forward with hands clasped behind his back. He has a receding hairline, sharp facial features, and a focused gaze. He wears a long coat. The background has a textured wall with swirling patterns and lines suggesting panels or a doorway.

artworks.title: Tiens, voilà un écriteau que ma femme a passé...
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man standing in profile, with hands resting on a cane. He wears a top hat, a long overcoat, striped pants, and low-heeled shoes. Nearby is a second person, likely a woman, shown from the back wearing a long dress and a bonnet. The scene includes a sign on the wall that reads "Logement A Louer." The background depicts a street with buildings and a sidewalk.

artworks.title: Madame Rabourdeau a sa première leçon
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals, a man and a woman, in a side profile. The man stands upright with a rope in his hand, while the woman leans forward as if pulling against the rope attached to her waist. The man has facial hair, a beard, wears a hat, a light-colored shirt and pants, and dark shoes. The woman wears a headscarf and a dark one-piece garment that covers her from shoulders to just above the ankles. She is barefoot. A seated woman in similar attire is also visible in the background. The setting seems to be indoors with a plain backdrop, suggesting a simple room or stage. The drawing is black and white with a textured appearance.

artworks.title: Les Barbotteuses
artworks.description: The image shows several people immersed in water, with their bodies visible from the waist up. The individuals are engaged in different activities. One person on the left is raising their hand, while another person is expressing an emotional reaction. To the right, a person is visible with crossed arms. The individuals have varied hairstyles, with some wearing head coverings. They are all wearing dark swimwear with short sleeves and rounded necklines. The scene takes place in a body of water, with a net behind them suggesting a swimming pool. In the background, two figures are seated on a bench, observing the activity. Another person is seen walking on a platform above the water, wearing similar clothing. The background is depicted with vertical lines.

artworks.title: A la buvette
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a dimly lit interior scene depicting two seated and two standing individuals. The two seated individuals are relaxed, smoking cigars, and appear to be in conversation, with a table set between them holding a carafe and two glasses. The setting suggests an informal or casual atmosphere, possibly a bar or lounge, with muted patterns decorating the background. The drawing is executed in monochrome, emphasizing the contrast between light and shadow to create a sense of depth and texture.

artworks.title: Fesant toutes partie de la plus belle moitié...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an indoor pool scene. The image contains several individuals by and in a swimming pool, all wearing swimwear from an earlier period. Two figures stand on a poolside deck, one with a head covering and the other sitting on a bench with water dripping off them. In the water, two figures are visible, one glancing up at the person sitting on the bench and the other swimming. In the background, there is a sketchy, shaded wall. The sketch is monochrome, using shading to imply depth and texture.

artworks.title: En Famille
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures in a whimsical domestic bathhouse scene. The figures wear loose-fitting garments and head coverings. One figure is adjusting a cap on a smaller figure next to them, while another figure interacts with a face peeking up from the water. Soft pencil strokes and shading provide detail on the clothing. The background features ornamental lines indicating an indoor structure.

artworks.title: Le Chiffonnier philosophe
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in a room. The setting features an older person and a younger one standing in a dimly lit space. The older figure appears to be pointing or instructing the child, who is looking up. Behind them is a shelf with utensils stored in a container. The room is mostly obscured, but the lighting gives a sense of a workshop or domestic space with a lantern mounted on the wall for ambient lighting. The shading and line work suggest texture and depth, with cross-hatching used to create shadow and form. The details depict a narrative moment captured in a monochromatic style.

artworks.title: Il y a trois mois, m'sieu l'vicomte posait... comme ça...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures interacting next to a framed portrait. The scene shows two individuals standing in front of a large framed portrait hanging on the wall. The drawing emphasizes the clothing and posture of the figures, with one holding a double-barreled rifle and the other holding a cane. The background includes loosely sketched patterns suggesting an interior setting, potentially a room with patterned wallpaper. The portrait on the wall depicts a third character looking at the viewer.

artworks.title: Des chargés d'affaires
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in a street setting. Both individuals are visible from head to toe. The person on the left stands with one arm raised to support a large basket balanced on their head. This individual has short hair and is dressed in a long-sleeved garment with vertical stripes and a long apron over it. They hold a smaller object in their free hand. The person on the right is standing with their back partially turned to the viewer, leaning slightly towards the left person. They have short hair and wear a hat, a collared shirt, and trousers. An apron is tied around their waist, and they carry two large flat, rounded objects under their right arm. The background depicts a cobblestone street and a textured wall.

artworks.title: Désolé, citoyenne... je ne reçois pas de chiens...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a street scene involving a carriage. The drawing depicts a city street with a horse-drawn carriage where passengers are either boarding or waiting to board. The grayscale illustration shows a detailed architectural backdrop with buildings that suggest an urban environment. A figure with formal attire is carrying a small dog and holding an umbrella, standing on the cobblestone pavement facing the carriage. Several figures are visible through the windows and at the top of the carriage, which is highlighted using shading techniques to create depth and texture. The artist has used hatchings and various line densities to convey shadows, textures, and movement within the city scene.
